entries.title: Micah 1:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The time when Micah prophesied. 2 He shews the wrath of God against Jacob for idolatry. 10 He exhorts to mourning.

Micah. 14,15; Jer 26:18 Jotham. 2Ch 27:1-32:33; Isa 1:1; Ho 1:1 which. Am 1:1; Hab 1:1 concerning. 5; Ho 4:15; 5:5-14; 6:10,11; 8:14; 12:1,2; Am 2:4-8; 3:1,2; 6:1

entries.title: Micah 1:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: all ye people. Heb. ye people all of them. hearken. 6:1,2; De 32:1; Ps 49:1,2; 50:1; Isa 1:2; Jer 22:29; Mr 7:14-16 Re 2:7,11,17,29; 3:6,13,22 all that therein is. Heb. the fulness thereof. Ps 24:1; 50:12 let. Ps 50:7; Jer 29:23; Mal 2:14; 3:5 the Lord from. Ps 11:4; 28:2; Jon 2:7; Hab 2:20

entries.title: Micah 1:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the mountains. Jud 5:4; Ps 97:5; Isa 64:1-3; Am 9:5; Na 1:5; Hab 3:6,10 2Pe 3:10-12; Re 20:11 the valleys. Zec 14:4 as wax. Ps 68:2 a steep place. Heb. a descent.

entries.title: Micah 1:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I will make. 3:12; 2Ki 19:25; Isa 25:2,12; Jer 9:11; 51:37; Ho 13:16 and I will pour. Jer 51:25; La 4:1; Eze 13:14; Hab 3:13; Mt 24:2

entries.title: Micah 1:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I will wail. Isa 16:9; 21:3; 22:4; Jer 4:19; 9:1,10,19; 48:36-39 I will go. Isa 20:2-4 a wailing. Job 30:29; Ps 102:6 owls. Heb. daughters of the owl.

entries.title: Micah 1:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: her wound is incurable. or, she is grievously sick of herwounds. Isa 1:5,6; Jer 15:18; 30:11-15 it. 2Ki 18:9-13; Isa 8:7,8 he. 12; 2Ch 32:1-23; Isa 10:28-32; 37:22-36

entries.title: Micah 1:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Declare. 2Sa 1:20; Am 5:13; 6:10 Aphrah. i.e., dust. Jos 18:23 Ophrah. roll. Job 2:8; Jer 6:26; La 3:29

entries.title: Micah 1:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Pass. Isa 16:2; Jer 48:6,9 thou inhabitant of Saphir. or, thou that dwellest fairly.Heb. inhabitress. having. 8; Isa 20:4; 47:2,3; Jer 13:22; Eze 16:37; Na 3:5 Zaanan. or, the country of flocks. Beth-ezel. or, a placenear.

entries.title: Micah 1:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Maroth. Ru 1:20 waited carefully. or, was grieved. 1Sa 4:13; Job 30:26; Isa 59:9-11; Jer 8:15; 14:19 but. 9; Isa 45:7; Am 3:6

entries.title: Micah 1:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: give. 2Sa 8:2; 2Ki 16:8; 18:14-16; 2Ch 16:1-3; Isa 30:6 to. or, for. houses. Ps 62:9; 118:8,9; 146:3,4 Achzib. that is, a lie. Jos 15:44

entries.title: Micah 1:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: will. Isa 7:17-25; 10:5,6; Jer 49:1 Mareshah. Jos 15:44 he, etc. or, the glory of Israel shall come to, etc. 1Sa 22:1; Isa 10:3 Adullam. Jos 15:35; 2Ch 11:7
